snippet.title: Light the Way OP 【Promo MV】•  Fan-made Luxiem Dating Sim
snippet.description:
Omg 😳 the MV has been released 🫣 was it everything you hoped for or more? 

Simporiem Studios and our especially talented editors have collaborated and would like to present to you the opening theme song for our fan game - Light the Way

PS. Other languages are available in closed captions setting!

💠Website for our game download (EXPECT FULL RELEASE ON APRIL 30✨👀):
https://simporiem-studios.itch.io/light-the-way

💠Follow our socials for more updates!
